subject: Greenfield invoice template & portal preference — start onboarding
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@greenfieldmfg.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Greenfield invoice template & portal preference — start onboarding

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for confirming the activation date for next month. To get AP connected cleanly, a couple quick questions so our onboarding form is aligned with your expectation: 

1) Do you plan to submit invoices via your portal (recommended) or send to our invoice email address as a fallback? If you prefer email, do you have a preferred subject token we should parse (e.g., GF-PO-####)?

2) Can you confirm whether you will send one invoice per PO or include multiple POs on a single PDF? We handle both, but routing rules differ and we want to avoid delays.

3) Attached is a very short example row layout we accept for CSV/CSV-like payloads — can you confirm field names or share your sample?

If easier, we can jump on a 20-minute call this week to walk through the portal setup. 

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships – Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onboarding_sample_rows.csv (csv)]

From: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@greenfieldmfg.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-11T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenfield invoice template & portal preference — start onboarding

Hi Jonas,

Quick answers: we prefer to use the portal for production — that is our primary path.

Fallback: email to accounts@greenfieldmfg.com will only be used by legacy suppliers; for you, please accept email fallback to invoices@greenfieldmfg.com with subject token "GF-INV" if it helps with automated parsing.

Invoices: we typically send one PDF per PO, but our finance team can batch up to 3 POs on one file for certain suppliers. We'll flag batched files with a header line in the PDF.

I attached an internal sample invoice (PDF) and a CSV export with the columns we export from our ERP. Hope that helps.

Best,
Maya Ortiz
AP Manager, Greenfield Manufacturing
[Attachment: GF_Invoice_Example.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: GF_export_columns.csv (csv)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-12T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Greenfield invoice template & portal preference — start onboarding

Folks,

Looping Karthik and Kim on the routing specifics. A couple operational notes: 

- If Greenfield will do portal-first, we should set the onboarding form to require: vendor_id, primary_contact, PO acceptance (single/multi-PO), and preferred fallback token.
- For our Dedicated ingestion rules, when we see subject contains "GF-INV" we should auto-map to the Greenfield vendor and enable PO-stamping.
- For multi-PO PDFs we have a manual QA step; can we keep that to a 24-hour SLA for validation so payment timing isn't impacted?

Can Karthik confirm expected changes to the ingestion config and Kim take point on updating the onboarding form?

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@greenfieldmfg.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-13T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenfield invoice template & portal preference — start onboarding

Hi Vanessa, Jonas,

Thanks for the clarity. A couple follow-ups from our side: 

- Our CSV export includes columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, tax, total. We can add a vendor_id column if needed.
- For subject tokens on email fallback, we will ask suppliers to include GF-INV at the start of the subject line (e.g., "GF-INV PO 12345").
- We prefer the QA step to be 24 hours as well. If there's a case where the system rejects a batched PDF, please notify our team immediately at ap-alerts@greenfieldmfg.com so we can resubmit.

Attaching the actual sample invoice PDF for format reference.

Maya
[Attachment: GF_Invoice_Example.pdf (pdf)]

Maya / team,

Perfect — thanks for confirming. Action items we will take from Redwood side: 

- Onboarding form: Kim will add a vendor_id field and a required fallback_subject_token field set to "GF-INV" for Greenfield. (Kim, please add the new field to the onboarding form and flag it live.)
- Ingestion config: Karthik to add a routing rule to map subject token "GF-INV" to the Greenfield vendor profile and enable PO-stamping.
- QA SLA: We will treat multi-PO PDFs as a manual-qa with a 24hr SLA; will push notifications to ap-alerts@greenfieldmfg.com on rejection.
- Next: Vanessa to schedule a short portal walk-through for your AP + supplier enablement team next Tuesday at 11:00 PT.

Maya — can you confirm that Tuesday 11:00 PT works for you and who from Greenfield should be on the call? Also, please confirm if the sample attachments you shared are representative of all your suppliers or if there is a separate legacy format we should expect.

Thanks again,
Jonas
